01 / 09

Project Overview

Aljáskaa is a home appliances brand developed to establish a modern and distinctive visual identity under the slogan: 'Power You Trust in Every Home — Built for a Better Home'.

The project scope covers complete Brand Identity Development, Logo System & Geometry, Color & Typography Standards, Custom Graphic Elements, Product Packaging & Storefront Mockups, and Social Media Campaigns.

Brand Name Aljáskaa (الجازيكا)
Industry Home Appliances
Brand Slogan A Smarter Home Tomorrow
Visual Inspiration Ice Mountains Geometry
02 / 09

Target Audience

The brand addresses two primary customer segments requiring durable cooling and modern household appliances.

01. Farm Owners & Commercial Users

Agricultural and commercial activities looking for heavy-duty cooling, freezing, and storage appliances that offer high reliability.

02. Everyday Families & Modern Homes

Individuals and families seeking smart refrigerators, washing machines, cookers, and air fryers that combine sleek design with energy efficiency.

03 / 09

Project Challenge

Developing a visual identity that communicates cooling power, durability, and smart technology while standing out in the competitive home appliances market.

04 / 09

Creative Direction & Idea Exploration

Transforming natural ice mountain peaks into sharp geometric lines that express cooling power, stability, and modern technology.

Symbol Anatomy
Mountain Peaks symbolize strength & reliability, Sharp Lines reflect technology & high performance, and the Diamond Frame creates visual balance.

Coupled with a custom-treated 'A' letterform and modern sans-serif typography, the mark is engineered to look commanding on stainless-steel appliances and illuminated storefronts.

05 / 09

Logo System & Construction

Complete logo lockups (Primary, Secondary Horizontal, Standalone Icon), construction grid, clear-space rules, and incorrect usage guidelines.

06 / 09

Visual Identity System

A cohesive system combining Deep Blue & Sky Blue with neutral grays, promotional accent colors, and geometric mountain patterns.

Approved Brand Color Palette

Deep Blue (#0F2747) expresses trust and stability, while Sky Blue (#2CC0F3) communicates cooling innovation and technology, supported by neutral grays and vibrant accent colors.

Sky Blue#2CC0F3

Typography & Graphic Language

The identity pairs the Cairo typeface family for Arabic (Light, Regular, Medium, Bold) with Aljaskaa Sans / Modified Geometric Sans for English.

Brand Applications & Packaging

Translating the visual system across showroom storefronts, product packaging boxes, delivery trucks, staff uniforms, business cards, and outdoor billboards.
